parent_objective: materialize no-training matched-current older-history source candidates before corpus export or training
blocked_by: M1390 requires causal history-necessity source materialization before new profile scaling or training
supersedes: exporting a temporal corpus from seed-thin M1379 rows

public_gates: M1391 must implement or run a no-training public source miner/smoke
M1391 must report matched-current distance histograms and source diversity
M1391 must report whether structural smoke thresholds are met
M1391 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not relax matching thresholds after seeing results

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements or runs the first no-training source materialization for matched-current older-history causal tasks
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure/source smoke only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source mining cannot produce matched-current candidates
stop if current-frame matching cannot be measured
stop if source-diversity metrics are omitted
stop if implementation requires actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: route to broader source sampling if too few candidates are found
route to simulator/task extension design if current artifacts cannot express same-current older-history ambiguity
route to source-selection redesign if candidates are source-narrow
route to branch synthesis if causal source materialization is infeasible

admission_evidence: M1390 defines matched-current older-history task families and thresholds
M1375/M1379 provide public source-rich artifacts but are not sufficient for corpus export
M1389 blocks more blind profile scaling
blocked_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
allowed_updates: source miner implementation or smoke command
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: source candidates are materialized or infeasibility is classified
matching-distance and source-diversity metrics are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1391 must report current-frame matching and cannot count rows that fail same-current or matched-current constraints as history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No-training source materialization over public M1375/M1379 artifacts and M1362 public-base checkpoint.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source candidates are too few or source-narrow, record the negative and route to broader source/task redesign before training.
allowed_claims: source miner implementation or smoke result
no promotion, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-training source miner can materialize matched-current older-history candidates and source-diversity diagnostics for the causal history-necessity branch.
success_criteria: source miner implementation or smoke artifact exists
result chooses next route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, training corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: result routes directly to training or claim expansion

commands.name: implementation
commands.command: implement or run no-training causal history source miner/smoke

decision_rule: M1391 passes structurally if it materializes or cleanly rejects no-training matched-current older-history candidates with matching and source-diversity metrics.
